security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by markdown backticks, local config edits, schema metadata, or benign shell substitutions. Two shell-script execution findings are confirmed because the skill asks users to run community bash automation, and one semantic finding covers remote package installation risk. No prompt injection or data exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Remote package and global tool installation
remediation.suggestion: Avoid global npm installs, pin exact package versions where practical, and document registry access before users run the setup scripts.

remediation.issue: Executable shell scripts from a community skill
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear pre-run summary, keep all paths quoted, and validate the project directory before file writes or cleanup commands.
Publish component source files directly or include a checksum and manifest so reviewers can verify archive contents easily.

content.value_statement: Complex Claude artifacts often need React, styled components, and a repeatable bundle step. This skill creates a Vite project and bundles it into one shareable HTML artifact.
actual_capabilities: Initializes a React 18 and TypeScript project with Vite.
Configures Tailwind CSS with shadcn/ui theme variables.
Adds path aliases for component and library imports.
Installs Radix UI and related shadcn/ui dependencies.
Extracts bundled shadcn/ui components into the generated project.
Bundles the finished app into a single self-contained HTML file.
limitations: Requires Node.js 18 or newer and a working npm or pnpm setup.
Uses package registry installs during initialization and bundling.
Best suited for complex React artifacts, not simple static HTML snippets.
Generated projects still need normal frontend testing before sharing.

use_cases.title: Build Component Demos
use_cases.description: Start a React project that already includes Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui components, and Radix dependencies.

use_cases.title: Package Internal Tools
use_cases.description: Turn a small React interface into one HTML file that can be reviewed or shared in a conversation.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Artifact

prompt_templates.title: Add shadcn/ui Layout
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a multi-panel React artifact that uses shadcn/ui buttons, tabs, cards, and form controls. Keep the design compact and professional.

prompt_templates.title: Bundle for Sharing
prompt_templates.prompt: After the React artifact is complete, run the bundle workflow and prepare the resulting single HTML artifact for review.

prompt_templates.title: Refine a Complex Artifact
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a complex React artifact with reusable components, responsive states, and clear interaction flows. Verify the bundled HTML before presenting it.

output_examples.input: Create a React dashboard artifact with tabs, cards, filters, and a table.
output_examples.output: A Vite React project is initialized with Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui components, and a dashboard interface ready to bundle.

output_examples.input: Package my completed artifact so it can be shared in Claude.
output_examples.output: The project is built with Parcel, assets are inlined, and a single bundle.html file is produced.

output_examples.input: Create a polished prototype using shadcn/ui dialogs and forms.
output_examples.output: The generated app includes configured dependencies, component imports, and a structured React interface for the requested workflow.

best_practices: Use this skill when the artifact needs React state, reusable components, or a polished component library.
Review package installs and generated files before running scripts in sensitive workspaces.
Test the bundled HTML in a browser before sharing it as a final artifact.
anti_patterns: Do not use this workflow for a small static page that can be written as one simple HTML file.
Do not run the scripts in a repository where dist or bundle.html contain important unrelated work.
Do not assume the bundled file is production ready without visual and functional review.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a React and TypeScript artifact project and can bundle it into one self-contained HTML file.

faq.question: Does it support shadcn/ui components?
faq.answer: Yes. It installs common Radix dependencies and extracts a bundled set of shadcn/ui component files.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it need internet access?
faq.answer: Yes. The setup and bundle scripts install packages from npm-compatible registries.

faq.question: Is it useful for simple HTML artifacts?
faq.answer: No. It is intended for complex artifacts that benefit from React, Tailwind CSS, and component tooling.

faq.question: What should I review before running it?
faq.answer: Review the shell scripts, package install steps, generated project path, and any existing files named dist or bundle.html.
